privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.s1_p1: At BeMatch ("we", "our", or "the Company"), we take your privacy very seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how your personal data is collected, used, shared, and protected when you use our application ("BeMatch") and related services.
privacy_page.s1_p2: By using our app, you agree to the data processing practices described in this policy.
privacy_page.s2_p: To provide you with a better matching experience, we collect the following types of data:
privacy_page.s2_li1: Registration Info: First name, last name, date of birth, gender, email address, and password.
privacy_page.s2_li2: Profile Contents: Photos, bio, education, profession, and interests uploaded to the app.
privacy_page.s2_li3: Device & Connection Data: IP address, device type, operating system, and browser data.
privacy_page.s2_li4: Location Data: Real-time GPS or IP-based location data (with your permission) to enable the "Nearby" feature.
privacy_page.s2_li5: Interaction Data: In-app messaging, matches, like/pass actions, and usage statistics.
privacy_page.s3_p: Your personal data is processed for the following purposes:
privacy_page.s3_li1: Algorithmically providing you with the most suitable potential matches.
privacy_page.s3_li2: Providing a secure and seamless communication infrastructure between users.
privacy_page.s3_li3: Enhancing user security by detecting and preventing fraud, spam, and rule violations.
privacy_page.s3_li4: Responding to customer service and technical support requests.
privacy_page.s3_li5: Analyzing app performance and developing new features.
privacy_page.s4_p: We never sell your data for targeted advertising. However, data may be shared in the following situations:
privacy_page.s4_li1: Other Users: Information you allow to be publicly visible on your profile (photos, name, interests) can be seen by other users.
privacy_page.s4_li2: Service Providers: Trusted partners performing essential functions like data storage, server hosting (Google Firebase), and analytics.
privacy_page.s4_li3: Legal Requirements: Limited information sharing with official authorities as a result of valid administrative or court orders.
privacy_page.s5_p: Your data is stored using highly secure, industry-standard infrastructures like Google Cloud Firestore. We use SSL/TLS encryption for data transmission. User passwords are not stored directly in the database; they are securely hashed using irreversible cryptography.
privacy_page.s6_p: You have the following rights over your personal data:
privacy_page.s6_li1: Learning what data is being processed and requesting a copy of it.
privacy_page.s6_li2: Correcting misleading or incomplete data via the Settings menu.
privacy_page.s6_li3: Revoking location and notification permissions at any time via your device.
privacy_page.s6_li4: Completely removing your account and associated data from our database by following the "Delete My Account" steps in the app.
privacy_page.s7_p: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this privacy policy, please feel free to contact us.

terms_page.title: Terms of Service
terms_page.s1_p: By downloading, accessing, or creating a BeMatch account, you agree to be legally bound by the following Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you do not agree to these terms in whole or in part, you must not use the application.
terms_page.s2_p: To create a BeMatch account and use our services, you must meet the following conditions:
terms_page.s2_li1: Be at least 18 years of age (or the age of majority in your jurisdiction).
terms_page.s2_li2: Not have been previously banned from our services.
terms_page.s2_li3: Ensure the age, gender, and photos declared on your profile are truthful.
terms_page.s3_p: We have strict rules to ensure users communicate on a safe platform. The following actions are strictly prohibited:
terms_page.s3_li1: Hate Speech or Harassment: Targeted, racist, sexist, or disturbing messaging towards other users.
terms_page.s3_li2: Catfishing: Opening an account using someone else's identity, photos, or personal information.
terms_page.s3_li3: Commercial and Spam: Advertising to other members without permission, requesting money, sharing third-party links.
terms_page.s3_li4: Violence or Nudity: Sharing pornographic content, promoting violence, or using disturbing imagery.
terms_page.s3_alert: Accounts found violating these rules via our complaint mechanisms will be permanently banned without notice (Ban).
terms_page.s4_p: You are entirely responsible for maintaining the security of the email/password and authorization codes you create for account access. BeMatch cannot be held liable for damages resulting from unauthorized third-party access to your account.
terms_page.s5_p: All content you create on your profile (photos, bio texts, etc.) belongs to you. However, by uploading them:
terms_page.s5_li1: You grant BeMatch a royalty-free license to host, display, and transfer the content to potential matches within the application.
terms_page.s5_li2: The application's interface, brand (BeMatch), logos, and software code are solely the property of our company and may not be copied or distributed.
terms_page.s6_p: BeMatch always reserves the right to modify application features, tie free services to paid subscription packages, or update this Terms of Service document with notice.
